name: A rise from nothing
about: A stable-born youth catches a lord's eye, fights, is knighted, and wins land of their own, or is cut down by a jealous bannerman or the first battle.
title: The Rise of {upstart}

new.memory: I was born in the stables at {patron.seat}, and I mean to die in a hall.

goal.text: hold land of my own, though I was born with none

fade: {upstart} serves on, a good sword in a crowded hall, and nobody sings of {upstart.him}.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: At the spring muster at {patron.seat}, a stable {upstart.man} called {upstart} unhorses a knight with a borrowed lance. {patron} asks the {upstart.man}'s name.

memory.patron: A stable {upstart.man} called {upstart} unhorsed a knight at my muster.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} laughs and tosses the {upstart.man} a coin for the show. {upstart} keeps the coin, and leaves {patron.seat} on foot before dawn.

memory.upstart: {patron} threw me a coin like a juggler. I left {patron.seat} on foot.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} takes {upstart} into {patron.his} household as a squire. The other squires put dung in {upstart.his} boots, once.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: Raiders come over the hills near {patron.seat}. {upstart} holds a ford with six men until {patron}'s horse comes up.

memory.patron: {upstart} held the ford when grown knights ran. I owe the {upstart.man} my lands.

die.how: I fell holding the ford for {patron}.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} rides in the lists at {patron.seat} in borrowed armour and is not unhorsed all day.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} is unhorsed in the last pass and laughed out of the lists. {upstart.He} goes back to the stables, and the horses do not laugh.

memory.upstart: They laughed me out of the lists at {patron.seat}. I went back to the horses.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: {patron} dubs {upstart} knight in the hall at {patron.seat}. {upstart.He} kneels a stable {upstart.man} and rises Ser {upstart.first}.

memory.upstart: {patron} knighted me in the hall at {patron.seat}. I knelt in straw and rose a knight.
memory.rival: {patron} knighted a stable {upstart.man}. What is a knighthood worth now?

beats.speaker: rival
beats.text: {rival} says at table that a stable {upstart.man} in a knight's cloak still smells of the stable. {upstart} answers with a fist.

memory.rival: {upstart} struck me at {patron}'s table, before everyone. A stable {upstart.man} struck me.
memory.upstart: {rival} humiliated me at table. I hit {rival.him}, and would again.

beats.text: {upstart} falls sick after a feast at {patron.seat}. The cup came from {rival}'s end of the table.

die.how: I drank from a cup at {patron}'s feast and never rose.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} lives, thinner and quieter. {patron} sends {rival} back to {rival.seat} and does not invite {rival.him} again.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {rival} demands satisfaction, and they fight on the green below {patron.seat} at dawn.

die.how: I died on the green at {patron.seat} at a stable {upstart.man}'s hand.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {upstart} walks off the green with {rival}'s blood on {upstart.his} sword and the whole of {patron.seat} watching.
{rival} runs {upstart} through on the green below {patron.seat}. The stable {upstart.man}'s knighthood lasted a single summer.

die.how: {rival} killed me on the green at dawn.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} grants {upstart} the lordship of {grant}. A {upstart.man} born in straw now sits a hall under {upstart.his} own banner.

memory.upstart: I hold {grant}. Born in the stables at {patron.seat}, and now I hold {grant}.
memory.patron: I gave {grant} to {upstart}, who was born in my stables.

upstart.text: repay {patron}, who raised me from the straw

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: There is no land to give, but {upstart} rides at {patron}'s right hand now, and men who once kicked {upstart.him} call {upstart.him} ser.
{upstart} is buried at {patron.seat}, under a stone {patron} pays for. The stable hands go to the grave on their own.

memory.patron: I buried {upstart}, who was born in my stables and died my knight.

beats.speaker: upstart
beats.text: {patron} dies, and with {patron.him} every promise made to {upstart}. The new lord of {patron.seat} has squires of {patron.his} own.
